depicted_variant: Falcon god standing on prow of underworld ferry carrying departed souls across dark river.

visual_requirements.description: Falcon standing on a boat, not human-headed deity
Ferryman carrying dead souls across underworld river

aura: Falcon-on-boat form c03 and underway ferry of souls c08 provide sacred awe, no invented crown/aura.
artistic_choices: Natural falcon anatomy, wings opened to balance on prow, not anthropomorphic falconman.
Three anonymous fully clothed translucent shadow soul-passengers editorially visualize c08; no glow, skeletons or specific identities.
Boat moves through physical current; oars/crew not claimed and omitted. Low prow camera makes falcon dominate at natural birdscale.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Nemty, the ancient Egyptian falcon god of ferrymen carrying the departed across the underworld river.
ANATOMY: ONE living FALCON standing firmly on the PROW OF A BOAT, ONE head, TWO natural piercing falcon eyes, curved falcon beak, TWO feathered WINGS and TWO taloned FEET. No human torso, crown, sun disk, jewellery, horns or invented symbols [nemty-c03].
MOMENT: Lean forward over the boat's prow toward low viewer with wings partly OPEN for balance, talons gripping wood, gaze commanding and direct while the ferry cuts strongly through dark current. THREE anonymous fully clothed ADULT soul-passengers sit deep behind in the boat as quiet visibly incorporeal dark silhouettes, upper bodies coherent but their lower edges delicately translucent within the ferry, faces mostly hidden, no skeletons or injuries.
POWER: ferryman of the afterlife carrying dead souls across the underworld river, show physical boat wake and shadowed passengers only, no glow, energy beams or floating glyphs [nemty-c08].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close view from just before prow; falcon's great face, spread shoulder feathers and talons dominate foreground, passengers small through depth, falcon proportion relative boat rail not a giant bird.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber light far across river gives rim on living falcon feathers and prow, deep walnut-black underworld water, ordinary low water mist.
SURFACE: layered russet-brown/slate falcon feathers, hooked beak, gripping talons, worn plain Egyptian-style wooden ferry and physical spray.
SETTING: river of the underworld, dark monumental rock banks secondary, no inscriptions or temple symbols [nemty-c08].
MOOD: reverent awe at active sacred guide and passage, never ordinary pet falcon, cute mascot, calm still life or landscape.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native 1254px and 200px inspected: one falcon with two wings and two taloned feet grips boat prow (c03); severe direct gaze and forward balancing wings dominate. Ferry cuts through current with three clothed shadowy soul passengers (c08), stern bank darkness and a remote light. No human-bird hybrid, crown, invented divine regalia, text or aura. Boat underway gives sacred active passage rather than passive bird portrait; awe and identity remain legible at 200px. All seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and talon, hull and passenger crops. Nemty appears as a falcon standing on a boat (nemty-c03): one natural falcon with one head, two eyes, a hooked beak and two wings half-open for balance. Its two taloned feet grip the prow post with normal toes and black talons. There are no extra limbs and no human body, crown or sun disk. It leans toward a low camera with a hard, direct stare. A plain wooden ferry cuts through dark water, throwing real spray. Three hooded, fully clothed, faceless seated passengers in shadow behind it stand for the souls of the dead being carried across the underworld river (c08); the receipt records them as an editorial choice. Monumental dark cliffs and a single low amber light lie behind. No glyphs or inscriptions: the hull shows plank lines only. No aura and no text. At 200px the bird, wings and talons dominate with the ferry of souls behind, and it reads as a sacred, imposing guide, not a pet bird.
